## Reading this workflow
Follow 01 → 05 from left to right. Only one intent lane is selected. Combined requests dispatch both retrieval jobs and meet at Merge.

**Lower lane:** one report retry maximum; the counter is visible. Metadata and unsupported requests go straight to the final response. HTTP failures converge on the lower-right handler.

**Saved artifacts:** E5 / Chroma reports and ViT images. ViT is not Kaggle CLIP. Ingestion is an offline administrative notebook task, never part of Ask.

**Local endpoints:** n8n :5685 · Python tools :8000 · Streamlit :8501.

## 01 · Receive and route
Normalize input → classify intent → validate tools.
Switch outputs: reports / images / combined / metadata / unsupported.

## 02 · Retrieve the right evidence
Top lanes: reports or images. Middle: both tools → Merge.
Bottom: metadata only. These paths never rebuild indexes.

## 03 · Validate evidence
Keep source identities, check sufficiency, then decide whether a generated answer is needed.
True continues right; insufficient evidence enters the retry lane.

## 04 · Generate and check
Freeze exact passages → local Qwen → check source quotations.
Only an accepted answer can be released. A failure may use the one retry.

## 05 · Respond
One consistent response for every path.
Answer / retrieval / metadata / abstention / rejection.

## 06 · One retry, then stop
Read this lane right → left. Counter 0 → 1; rewrite; retrieve reports again.
The next failure abstains. Images are retained for combined requests.

## 07 · Tool unavailable
Transport errors return safe JSON with no answer.
This is an error exit, not another retry loop.
